vidext_auto.title: AI Automation Engineer
vidext_auto.description: At **Vidext**, I returned as an **AI automation expert**, developing **pipelines** and **processes** that allow the company to **automate** tasks, saving time and money. I also contribute my **AI knowledge** to improve company processes and develop new solutions.

solver.title: AI Engineer
solver.description: At **Solver**, I studied client needs and data, developing **AI models** and researching **technologies** needed by the company. I also completed my thesis focused on **OCR-Free models** for visual document understanding (**VDU**).

vidext.title: University Internship
vidext.description: At **Vidext**, I learned to develop web applications using **React** and **Next.js**. I created the company's **landing page** and an **internal application** for employees.

laberit.title: University Internship
laberit.description: During my internship, I learned to manage and develop extensions for **Microsoft's ERP 'Navision'**.

fiverr.title: Freelance Image Editor
fiverr.description: On this page I have made my **image editing skills** available to a variety of clients, with clients from all over the world. My work varied from client to client, but some examples are: Images for product promotion, photo and portrait retouching or image creation for digital marketing (Amazon).

puntiseguit.title: Tutoring Teacher
puntiseguit.description: At Punt I Seguit, I had the opportunity to teach students from 1st year of ESO to 2nd year of Bachillerato, reinforcing their learning to improve their grades. In addition to that, and motivated to teach, since I entered university I have taught other classmates in a formal way.
